site.name: Bahçeden
site.tagline: Straight from the grower, no wholesale market in between.

storefront.title: Storefront
storefront.subtitle: Fresh produce shipped directly by growers
storefront.emptyTitle: No products in the storefront yet
storefront.emptyBody: Products will appear here once growers add them.

detail.noDescription: The producer has not added a description.
detail.notFoundBody: This product may have been unpublished or may never have existed.
detail.dispatch: {days, plural, one {The producer ships within # business day} other {The producer ships within # business days}}
detail.notReady: The seller is not ready to sell yet; this product cannot be bought right now.

errors.title: Products could not be loaded
errors.body: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

fields.codeHint: The 6-digit code sent to your email

register.title: Sign up
register.intro: Create an account with your email address and a password. You can use it right away.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with your email address and password.
login.signInRequired: Sign in to see this page.
login.passwordChanged: Your password was changed and your open sessions were signed out. Sign in with your new password.

verification.title: Email verification
verification.successBody: Thank you. You can keep using your account.
verification.missingToken: The link looks incomplete. Make sure you opened the full link from the email, or request a new link from My account.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.intro: Enter your new password. Once it changes, you are signed out on every device.
resetPassword.missingToken: The link looks incomplete. Make sure you opened the full link from the email, or request a new link.

myAccount.title: My account
myAccount.role: {role, select, ROLE_CUSTOMER {Buyer} ROLE_SELLER {Seller} ROLE_ADMIN {Administrator} other {Unknown role}}
myAccount.notVerifiedBody: You have not verified your email address. This does not stop you from using your account.
myAccount.resent: We sent a new link to your email address.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: We could not complete your request right now. Please try again in a little while.
errors.unavailable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.crossSite: This request was rejected because it came from another site.
errors.invalidRequest: The request could not be read.

sessionRefresh.title: Refreshing your session
sessionRefresh.body: You have been inactive for a while; we are safely refreshing your session. You will return to your page in a moment.

card.title: Selling
card.inviteBody: Apply as a producer to sell what you grow without middlemen.

application.title: Seller application
application.intro: To sell your produce on Bahçeden, send your producer details and one document. An administrator reviews your application and we email you the decision.

fields.displayNameHint: This name appears next to your products in the storefront.
fields.phoneHint: Only administrators see it, to contact you about your application.
fields.documentHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG; at most 10 MB. Only administrators see the document.

application.documentType: {type, select, CKS_CERTIFICATE {Farmer registration (ÇKS) certificate} TAX_CERTIFICATE {Tax certificate} other {Document}}
application.documentTypeHint: {type, select, CKS_CERTIFICATE {Issued by the Farmer Registration System} TAX_CERTIFICATE {Issued by the tax office} other {Document}}

errors.documentType: The document must be a PDF, JPEG or PNG file.
errors.documentTooLarge: The document can be at most 10 MB.

verifyFirst.title: Verify your email first
verifyFirst.body: We will email you the result of your application. Please verify your email address before applying.

status.label: {status, select, PENDING {Under review} APPROVED {Approved} REJECTED {Rejected} SUSPENDED {Suspended} other {Unknown}}
status.pendingBody: An administrator is reviewing your details and document. We will email you the decision.
status.approvedBody: Your producer record was approved and the seller role was added to your account.
status.rejectedBody: You can correct your details based on the reason and resend them with a new document.
status.suspendedBody: While suspended, your products are not shown in the storefront.

list.title: My products
list.intro: Add and manage your listings here. A draft with a photo appears in the storefront as soon as you publish it.
list.emptyBody: Add your first product; buyers will see it once you upload a photo and publish it.
list.notApprovedTitle: Your seller record is not approved
list.notApprovedBody: An approved seller record is required to add and manage listings.

listings.status: {status, select, DRAFT {Draft} PUBLISHED {Published} ARCHIVED {Archived} REMOVED {Removed} other {Unknown}}

form.newIntro: Enter the details first; the listing is saved as a draft. Then you can add photos and publish it.
form.name: Product name
form.descriptionHint: Optional. Details a buyer would like to know, such as how it was grown or when it was picked.
form.stockHint: The amount you have; with zero the listing shows as "out of stock".
form.stockInvalid: Enter a whole number of 0 or more for stock.
form.removedTitle: This listing was removed by an administrator
form.removedBody: You can correct the listing, but an administrator republishes it. Reason: {reason}
form.dispatchOption: {days, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}
form.dispatchHint: Within how many business days can you hand an order to the carrier? Buyers see this on the product page.

photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Up to 5 photos. The first photo is the cover shown on the storefront card.
photos.empty: No photos yet. Add at least one photo to publish.
photos.hint: JPEG or PNG, at most 10 MB. Location data is removed.
photos.tooLarge: The photo can be at most 10 MB.
photos.wrongType: The photo must be a JPEG or PNG file.

actions.title: Publishing
actions.draftBody: Drafts are not shown in the storefront.
actions.publishedBody: The listing is shown in the storefront.
actions.archivedBody: Archived listings are hidden; restoring makes it a draft.
actions.removedBody: The listing stays hidden until an administrator reopens it.

sellers.title: Seller applications
sellers.intro: Review applications and decide on them. Applicants are notified of decisions by email.
sellers.tab: {status, select, PENDING {Pending} APPROVED {Approved} REJECTED {Rejected} SUSPENDED {Suspended} other {Other}}
sellers.emptyBody: You can check another tab or wait for new applications.

detail.openDocument: Open the document in a new tab
detail.historyItem: {to, select, PENDING {Put under review} APPROVED {Approved} REJECTED {Rejected} SUSPENDED {Suspended} other {Changed}}

actions.rejectBody: The applicant will see the reason and receive it by email; they can correct and resend.
actions.suspendBody: The seller role is removed and their products leave the storefront. The reason is shown to the seller and sent by email.

products.title: Listings
products.intro: Review published listings. A removed listing leaves the storefront; the seller sees the reason and receives it by email.
products.removeBody: The listing leaves the storefront. The seller sees the reason and can correct it; you reopen it.

orders.title: Undelivered orders
orders.intro: Review orders the carrier could not deliver; refund the buyer or close with a reason. The decision is emailed to the buyer and the producer.
orders.decisionIntro: Decide after talking to the buyer and, if needed, the producer. A refund does not restock the products.

actions.refundBody: The products and the shipping fee ({amount}) are refunded to the buyer's card; the producer earns no payout. Your note is sent to both sides.
actions.closeBody: No money moves and the producer's payout stands. Your reason is sent to the buyer and the producer.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for may have moved or may never have existed.

reasonDialog.label: Reason
reasonDialog.hint: Between 10 and 500 characters. Shown to the other party as written.
reasonDialog.required: The reason must be at least 10 characters.
reasonDialog.optionalHint: At most 500 characters. If you write one, it is shared with the other party.

payout.title: Payment details
payout.intro: Payments for your sales go to this account. Enter your details once; when the payment institution approves them, your products can be bought.
payout.missing: You have not entered payment details yet. Until you do, your listings appear in the storefront but cannot be bought.
payout.active: Your payment account is active. Your products can be bought.
payout.rejected: The payment institution did not accept your details. Check them and submit again; until then your products cannot be bought.

form.privacy: For your security, the saved identification number and IBAN are not shown again; enter both in full when saving. Only the payment institution and administrators see these details.
form.legalTypeOption: {type, select, INDIVIDUAL {Individual} SOLE_PROPRIETOR {Sole proprietorship} COMPANY {Company} other {Other}}
form.taxId: {type, select, COMPANY {Tax number} other {Turkish national ID number}}
form.ibanHint: 26 characters starting with TR; spaces are fine.

notice.title: Your products cannot be bought yet
notice.body: Complete your payment details so buyers can pay.

cart.navWithCount: {count, plural, one {My cart, # item} other {My cart, # items}}
cart.title: My cart
cart.emptyBody: Add fresh products from the storefront to your cart.
cart.hasUnavailable: Your cart has products that cannot be bought right now. Remove them before ordering.

add.signIn: Sign in to add to cart

group.freeShippingRemaining: Add {amount} more from this producer for free shipping.
group.dispatch: {days, plural, one {The producer ships within # business day} other {The producer ships within # business days}}

addresses.title: My addresses
addresses.intro: Manage your delivery addresses here. We currently deliver only to: {provinces}.
addresses.empty: You have no saved addresses yet.
addresses.notDeliverable: No delivery to this province right now

form.title: Address name
form.phoneHint: The carrier uses this number to reach you on delivery.
form.provinceHint: Only the provinces we deliver to are listed.
form.addressLineHint: Neighbourhood, street, building and flat number.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.withdrawalNotice: Fresh produce cannot be returned after delivery. You can cancel before the producer ships the order.
checkout.addressRequired: Choose or add a delivery address.
checkout.someNotDeliverable: Some of your saved addresses are in provinces we do not deliver to right now; they are not listed.

return.title: Payment result
return.heading: {status, select, PAID {Your order was received} PAYMENT_FAILED {The payment failed} PAYMENT_EXPIRED {The payment time ran out} CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK {Products ran out, your payment is being refunded} other {Waiting for your payment}}
return.body: {status, select, PAID {The payment for order {number} was received. We will let you know when the producers ship.} PAYMENT_FAILED {The payment for order {number} could not be taken. Your cart is still there; you can try again.} PAYMENT_EXPIRED {The payment for order {number} was not completed in time. Any amount taken is refunded; your cart is still there.} CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK {A product in order {number} ran out while you were paying. Your full payment will be refunded to your card; your cart is still there.} other {The payment for order {number} is not complete yet. Check again in a moment.}}

orders.title: My orders
orders.status: {status, select, PENDING_PAYMENT {Awaiting payment} PAID {Paid} PAYMENT_FAILED {Payment failed} PAYMENT_EXPIRED {Expired} CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK {Out of stock, refunded} other {Unknown}}
orders.sellerOrderStatus: {status, select, PENDING_PAYMENT {Awaiting payment} NEW {Being prepared} SHIPPED {Shipped} DELIVERED {Delivered} DELIVERY_FAILED {Not delivered} REFUNDED {Refunded} CLOSED {Closed} CANCELLED {Cancelled} VOID {Did not go through} other {Unknown}}
orders.dispatchOverdue: The producer missed the dispatch deadline. You can still cancel the order.
orders.cancelledBy: {by, select, SELLER {Cancelled by the producer.} other {Cancelled by you.}}

cancel.buyerBody: The products and shipping fee from this producer are refunded to your card. Other producers in your order are not affected.
cancel.sellerBody: The buyer is refunded in full for the products and shipping, and the products are added back to your stock. Your reason is shared with the buyer.

orders.shippingNote: {status, select, DELIVERY_FAILED {The package could not be delivered to you. We will look into it, contact you and let you know the outcome by email.} REFUNDED {As the package could not be delivered, this producer's products and the shipping fee were refunded to your card.} CLOSED {The undelivered shipment was reviewed and closed without a refund; the reason is in your email.} other {}}

sellerOrders.title: Incoming orders
sellerOrders.intro: Your paid orders. Ship each order within the time you declared.
sellerOrders.emptyTitle: {status, select, NEW {No orders to prepare} SHIPPED {No orders in transit} DELIVERED {No delivered orders} DELIVERY_FAILED {No undelivered orders} REFUNDED {No refunded orders} CLOSED {No closed orders} other {No cancelled orders}}
sellerOrders.overdue: The dispatch deadline has passed. The buyer may cancel; ship as soon as possible.
sellerOrders.shippingNote: {status, select, DELIVERY_FAILED {The carrier could not deliver the package to the buyer. The team will review it, decide and let you know by email.} REFUNDED {As the package could not be delivered, the buyer was refunded; this order earns no payout.} CLOSED {The undelivered shipment was closed without a refund; your payout stands.} other {}}

shipments.title: Shipment
shipments.status: {status, select, CREATED {Awaiting drop-off} HANDED_OVER {Handed to carrier} IN_TRANSIT {In transit} DELIVERED {Delivered} DELIVERY_FAILED {Not delivered} CANCELLED {Cancelled} other {Unknown}}
shipments.handoverHint: Print the label, stick it on the package and drop the package off at a carrier branch. If you have no printer, tell the shipment code at the branch.

prepare.title: Prepare for shipping
prepare.intro: Pack the products and choose the package size. Once the shipment is created, the label and shipment code appear here.
prepare.sizeHint: {size, select, SMALL {About a shoe box, up to 5 kg} MEDIUM {About a fruit crate, up to 15 kg} LARGE {Large box, up to 30 kg} other {}}
